name: fm.emergent/emergent-fm
title: Emergent.FM
description: Daily AI tool news for agents: what changed in AI developer tools, with trust labels and sources.

tools.name: latest_items
tools.description: The newest published entries of the Emergent.FM agent feed, newest first: the daily show's items, the site's stories and wire rows, each with a trust label and a source link. A story carries its topic; filter by kind or topic.

limit.description: How many entries at most, 1 to 50. Default 20.

kind.description: Only this kind: item (the daily show's picks), story (the site's own stories) or wire.

topic.description: Only newsroom stories with this tag: models, coding_agents, agent_skills, mcp_servers, orchestration, memory_verification, personal_agents, launches, workflows. Shows and wire rows have no tag here.

tools.name: items_by_date
tools.description: Every published entry of one day (New York time): that day's show items, its newsroom stories and its wire rows. Covers the feed's last 30 shows, six weeks of stories and at most 500 wire rows.

date.description: A day in New York time, YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-17.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Published entries filtered by tool, vendor, change type, a story's topic and words in the text, newest first. Searches one read of at most 500 entries, made of the last 30 shows and the newest wire rows.

tool.description: The tool's exact name, matched without regard to case.

vendor.description: The vendor's exact name, matched without regard to case.

change_type.description: The exact change type, for example Pricing or Release, matched without regard to case.

text.description: Words to find in the headline, summary or text, matched without regard to case.

topic.description: Only newsroom stories with this tag: models, coding_agents, agent_skills, mcp_servers, orchestration, memory_verification, personal_agents, launches, workflows. Shows and wire rows have no tag here.

limit.description: How many entries at most, 1 to 50. Default 20.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One published article as Markdown: its canonical address, feed id, publish and modified dates, any correction, key points, sections, updates and linked sources. Takes a feed entry's _emergent_fm.article_id (a story id like "story-6", a change id like "change-12" or a guide id like "guide-openai-batch"), or the entry's id or url (its page address); a change linked to a story answers with the story, and a guide answers with its public part only (title, summary, format, sources, dossier). A deleted story or withdrawn change is not found.

id.description: The article to read: a feed entry's _emergent_fm.article_id, like "story-6"; a tracked change's, like "change-12"; a guide's, like "guide-openai-batch"; or the entry's id or url itself, like "https://emergent.fm/stories/6". A change linked to a story answers with the story. A guide answers with its public part: title, summary, format, sources and dossier; its full body is on a reader's own connection.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: One published entry by id, like "item-45", "story-6" or "wire-123". An id that is not published, or a deleted story, is not found.

id.description: An entry's id: its "_emergent_fm" kind and id joined by a hyphen, like "item-45", "story-6" or "wire-123".
